options.label: Graphics backend
options.description: How mGBA draws the picture. OpenGL is the usual choice; Software works everywhere but is slower.

options.label: Aspect ratio
options.description: Keep the console's own picture shape, or stretch it to fill the screen.

options.label: Integer scaling
options.description: Only enlarge the picture by whole steps, so every pixel has the same size. Leaves borders around it.

options.label: Screen filter
options.description: Sharp keeps crisp square pixels; Smooth blurs them slightly when the picture is enlarged.

notes: config.ini keys are read from [ports.qt] first: mCoreConfigInit(&m_config, PORT) with PORT "qt" makes the port section "ports.qt" (src/platform/qt/ConfigController.h:67, ConfigController.cpp:117, src/core/config.c:151-157); _lookupValue tries overrides (-C), then [ports.qt], then the root section (src/core/config.c:49-77). The Qt settings dialog writes [ports.qt] too (mCoreConfigSetIntValue uses config->port, src/core/config.c:351-353).

Booleans are integers: _lookupBoolValue is strtol and drops a value with trailing text, so 'true' is ignored (src/core/config.c:91-104); the frontend writes 0/1 (ConfigController::setOption(bool) -> mCoreConfigSetIntValue, src/platform/qt/ConfigController.cpp:258-259).

lockAspectRatio (default 1, ConfigController.cpp:130), lockIntegerScaling and resampleVideo (bilinear filtering) are read by mCoreConfigMap (src/core/config.c:420-423) and applied to the display at game start by Display::configure (src/platform/qt/Display.cpp:106-111) and Window's ConfigOptions (src/platform/qt/Window.cpp:1554-1594). Our -C arguments only set savegamePath/savestatePath, so nothing on the command line shadows these.
Integer scaling with aspect 'stretch': each axis is scaled by its own whole step (clampSize, src/platform/qt/utils.h:49-58; src/platform/opengl/gl.c:88-93).

renderer: the display driver is a QSettings value, not a config.ini key: ~/.config/mgba/qt.ini (configDir() + "qt.ini", QSettings::IniFormat, src/platform/qt/ConfigController.cpp:110-115), key displayDriver with no group, so QSettings' [General] section (setQtOption, ConfigController.cpp:299-305). Read once at startup, before the window exists (src/platform/qt/GBAApp.cpp:56-57). Values: Display::Driver QT = 0, OPENGL = 1, OPENGL1 = 2 (src/platform/qt/Display.h:29-33); default OPENGL when built with GL (Display.cpp:18-22). The pkgforge 0.10.5 AppImage has DisplayGL and the GLES2 backend (strings in bin/mgba-qt and libmgba.so). OPENGL1 (forced GL 1.x) is not offered.

Left out: resolution and widescreen_hack (no such setting for GB/GBA), vsync (videoSync is 'Sync to video', emulation pacing; the swap interval is 1 whenever audio or video sync is on, src/platform/qt/DisplayGL.cpp:768-771, so 'off' would not turn VSync off), show_fps (showFps only writes the FPS in the window title, src/platform/qt/Window.cpp:1186-1199, invisible in fullscreen).
